title: Weekly growth sync
turns: Morning everyone. Let's go round. Sara, you first.
Thanks Alex. Signups were up eight percent last week, mostly from the new referral link.
Nice. Rahul, how did the onboarding email test go?
The shorter email won. Activation went from thirty one to thirty six percent. I want to ship it to everyone.
Before we do, can we check it with the Spanish users? The short version drops the setup video.
Fair point Grace. I can run it on the Spanish segment for one more week.
Let's do that. The short email ships to English users now, and Spanish waits a week.
On referrals, I'd like to double the reward for the holiday period.
About four thousand dollars if usage stays the same. I'll write up the numbers.
Send me the write up by Wednesday and I'll decide then.
Last thing from me. The app store rating dropped to four point two after the update.
That's probably the login bug. Engineering has a fix in review.
Then I'll reply to the worst reviews once the fix is live.
decisions: The short onboarding email ships to English users now; Spanish users wait one more week of testing
